sessions.label: Practice 1
narrative: George Russell set the pace in Practice 1 with a 1:45.387.

Nico Hulkenberg left the most time on the table: their fastest lap (1:46.871) was 0.434s slower than the theoretical lap built from their own best sectors (1:46.437), so there is more pace in the car than the lap time shows.
Charles Leclerc had the highest speed-trap reading, 339.0 km/h.
On long runs, Alexander Albon's SOFT-tyre stint (stint 3, 8 laps) had the best clean average pace at 107.648s/lap (slowest lap of the stint dropped as an outlier).

Context on George Russell's pace: “'I’m not in the fight for the drivers’ title' – George Russell concedes doubts over title challenge after Antonelli's Ma” (— 'I’m not in the fight for the drivers’ title' – George Russell concedes doubts over title challenge after Antonelli's Ma, Formula1.com).

Context on Alexander Albon's long-run pace: “The Azerbaijan Grand Prix will be a huge weekend for the Williams team as they finally introduce the long-awaited major upgrade package for the FW48. Up until now the 2026 season has been a painful one for drivers...” (— Why the FW48 upgrade package in Baku is so crucial for Williams, Formula1.com).
